CVE-2013-0221.title: The SUSE coreutils-i18n.patch for GNU coreutils allows context-de ...
CVE-2013-0221.description: The SUSE coreutils-i18n.patch for GNU coreutils allows context-dependent attackers to cause a denial of service (segmentation fault and crash) via a long string to the sort command, when using the (1) -d or (2) -M switch, which triggers a stack-based buffer overflow in the alloca function.
